title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Universal Senior Citizen Security Disability Pension and Care Guarantee Bill
objective: Track universal pension coverage for senior citizens and disabled persons and doorstep medicine delivery.
affected_groups: Senior citizens and persons with disabilities

indicators.name: Senior Citizen and Disability Pension Coverage Rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of eligible senior citizens and disabled persons receiving direct monthly pension transfers.

oversight.body: National Senior Citizen and Disability Welfare Board
oversight.composition: Senior citizen advocates, disability rights jurists, medical experts
oversight.powers: Statutory audit and pension disbursement directive

complaints.channel: Senior Citizen & Disability Rights Helpline & Portal

triggers.condition: Disruption or delay of monthly pension transfer to senior citizens or disabled persons exceeding 15 days.
triggers.responsible_body: National Senior Citizen and Disability Security Authority
triggers.correction: Immediate pension release and interest penalty directive
